+# Public release notice (v6.8.2 JCIS compliance)
+
+This is the JCIS-compliance public-minimised release of N1-MHKit prepared for Journal of Computer Information Systems review and citation. It aligns the public repository package with the v6.8.2 JCIS manuscript package while preserving the public release boundary, public tables, figure sources, validation scripts and non-clinical interpretation boundary.
+
+This release includes public-minimised processed tables, public-specific metadata, documentation, reproducible figure-source files, validation scripts and publication-ready PDF/SVG/PNG/TIFF figure exports.
+
+Source-layer files, source media objects, high-resolution temporal details, source filenames, contextual text, raw ECG PDF reports, PCG/WAV audio files and detailed participant-context materials are excluded from this public release. It is non-clinical and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment guidance, device certification, causal inference or population-level health conclusions.
+
+No generative AI image model was used to create, generate or alter the figures or artwork.

+# N1-MHKit public-minimised release (v6.8.2 JCIS compliance)
+
+N1-MHKit is a reproducible data-management artifact for multimodal personal health monitoring information systems. This v6.8.2 public-minimised release aligns the repository package with the Journal of Computer Information Systems submission package by providing code, metadata, documentation, public-minimised processed tables and reproducible manuscript figure sources.
+
+## Creator and maintainer
+
+Antonio Clim, PhD  
+Department of Economic Informatics and Cybernetics, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Bucharest, Romania  
+Email: antonio.clim@csie.ase.ro  
+ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4745-0431  
+Web of Science ResearcherID: AAC-7605-2019  
+Scopus Author ID: 55753988600
+
+## Scope
+
+This public package is deliberately smaller than the restricted verification package. It is intended for research-software inspection, data-management review, reproducibility checking of public-minimised artifacts and documentation of the Design Science Research artifact.
+
+## Included
+
+- Public-minimised processed tables.
+- Public-minimised data dictionary.
+- Public-specific Design Science Research traceability metadata.
+- Public-release gate documentation.
+- Reproducible figure sources for manuscript Figure 1, Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S1.
+- PDF, SVG, high-resolution PNG and 1200-dpi TIFF figure exports.
+- Public package smoke-test, schema-check and integrity-audit scripts.
+
+## Excluded
+
+Withheld source-layer files, source media objects, high-resolution temporal details, source filenames, participant context and contextual text are not part of this public package. These materials are outside the public release boundary.
+
+## Figure provenance
+
+The main manuscript figures are generated by deterministic Python scripts from CSV/JSON figure-source files. Supplementary Figure S1 is generated from public-minimised paired values. No generative AI image tool was used to create, generate or alter any figure or artwork.
+
+To regenerate all manuscript figures, run:
+
+```bash
+python code/figures/generate_all_manuscript_figures.py
+```
+
+## Validation
+
+To run the public-package checks:
+
+```bash
+python code/public_package_smoke_test.py
+python code/validate_public_release.py --root .
+python code/figures/generate_all_manuscript_figures.py
+```
+
+## Interpretation boundary
+
+The demonstration package is non-clinical. It does not support diagnosis, treatment guidance, device certification, causal inference or population-level health conclusions. The contribution is the curation artifact and its documentation.
+
+## JCIS submission compliance note
+
+Version v6.8.2 aligns the public repository package with the JCIS v6.8.2 submission package. The public tables, validation scripts, privacy boundary and figure-generation sources remain within the public-minimised boundary. The repository continues to exclude source-layer and restricted verification materials.
